title: Listening Drill — Ticket scanner comparison
description: Project planning dialogue. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Ticket scanner comparison
sections.transcript:
COORDINATOR: Thanks for joining this planning meeting about ticket scanning. The progress report is due on Monday. We need to agree what can be ready before then.

MEMBER: I'll start by checking the operator notes. That should tell us whether the previous team has already solved part of the problem.

COORDINATOR: Good. For the trial we will use the portable scanner. Send your results to Eleanor first, not to the whole group. I don't want unconfirmed figures copied into the report.

MEMBER: Understood. We should also remember that we cannot test during a live event. I'll make a note of that in the schedule.
